title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Daily Note Service Rate for Linked Members (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Rate rule.** On a refund of a Finch Note left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a member whose Finch Circle number was captured on the transaction and whose active membership was enrolled at least the veteran months of 60 months before the request date (whole months) receives the veteran daily note service rate of $0.50 per day; one whose number was captured on the transaction and whose active membership was enrolled fewer than 60 months before it receives the linked daily note service rate of $0.25 per day. A customer whose Finch Circle number was not captured on the transaction, or who has no active membership, is outside this rule.

The number's capture is shown on the purchase record; the enrollment date is that of the active membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program records.

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Number captured on the transaction | Whole months since enrollment of the active membership | Daily rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 60 | $0.50 |
| Yes | 59 | $0.25 |
| Yes | 4 | $0.25 |
| Yes | no active membership | outside this rule |
| No | 130 | outside this rule |
